design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Permanent BMPs must remove at least 80% of the increase in TSS load from development; capture volume is sized from annual pollutant load (L = A × P × Rv × C × 0.226) and BMP-specific TSS removal efficiency.

evidence.excerpt: The Edwards Aquifer rules are an effective mechanism we can use to protect this valuable resource. Found in Title 30 Texas Administrative Code Chapter 213
Complying with the Edwards Aquifer Rules Technical Guidance on Best Management Practices
RG-348 Revised July 2005 Includes Errata Sheet (March 28, 2009) and Addendum Sheet (Jan. 20, 2017).
The Edwards Aquifer Rules (30 TAC Chapter 213) regulate activities having the potential for polluting the Edwards Aquifer
Structural BMPs located in the floodplain should be constructed with the wall elevation of any basins or ponds higher than the elevation of the 100 year flood at that location.
The selected BMP or combination of BMPs must reduce the increase in total suspended solids (TSS) load associated with development by at least 80%.
